definition: The inverse frame-45 probe uses the validated GPU RK4 spring and support definitions inside the existing A5 selected domain.
supportConstruction: area-attributed per-vertex support springs and same-island neighbor anchors from the calibrated GPU support family
massAndDamping: not used by the offline static inverse equilibrium; the RK4 sensitivity gate uses the calibrated masses and RK4 integrator
domainLimitation: The frame-45 static inverse is run on the existing A5 selected facial domain, not the full GPU RK4 island. This is explicit and is not presented as a full GPU trajectory replay.

sensitivity.triangle: exact Goal 1 attachment on source island 50
